i13_db_merge_shape.instructions: Which merge shape best integrates the K22 raw DB observer and K23 RETURNING observer into the sealed catalogue, checker, runtime adapter, and ordinary Can surface? The I13 card requires a catalogue.json delta plus a Can helper package and typed example. K22/K23 are pure in-memory doubles (no live databases, no drivers, no sockets): namespace receipts carrying digests only, pinned identity-bound connections, single-conversation reads, lexeme-exact numbers, code-unit-exact text, byte-exact bytes, null-vs-empty distinction, row order, and RETURNING payload-vs-final comparisons, with every failure naming its engine/driver/sql layer. K22 states the normative independence scope: the observer never imports, calls, or reads adapter code, values, or state; adapter claims are compared AGAINST observer facts, and the observer never derives a fact FROM an adapter claim. QD1 will have Can exercise C RETURNING and check independent final rows on PG/SQLite legs. The runtime ship boundary forces any runtime merge to be a port, not an import. P14 is blocked, so whatever lands stays provisional with no execution credit.
